Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODMenuBar

EnableCommand

Mac OS

The EnableCommand method enables or disables the specified menu item.

void EnableCommand (in ODCommandID cmdNumber, 
                    in ODBoolean enable);
cmdNumber
The command ID of the menu item to be enabled or disabled. On the Mac OS platform, the command ID is defined as a signed 32-bit value.
enable
kODTrue if the menu item is to be enabled, or kODFalse if the menu item is to be disabled.
